title: Volcano, Indonesia, 5 November 2024 (VO20241105IDN)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Volcano, Indonesia, 5 November 2024 (VO20241105IDN), from 2 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: VO20241105IDN, GDACS ID: 1000099**  This map illustrates the population potentially exposed following the Lewotobi Laki-Laki volcanic eruption. Based on Worldpop spatial demographic data, ~11,400; ~26,000 and 37,000 people live within a 5km; 7.5km and 10km radius zone from the volcano crater.
This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).

HDX datasets:

- [Potential population exposure around Lewotobi Laki-Laki volcano](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/potential-population-exposure-around-lewotobi-laki-laki-volcano)
- [UNOSAT Live Web map - Lewotobi volcanic eruption, Indonesia](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/unosat-live-web-map-lewotobi-volcanic-eruption-indonesia)
